# 410 Muscle Therapy

> Specialized performance recovery bodywork, mobility restoration, and injury prevention clinic based in Timonium, Maryland. Offering clinical orthopedic massage, fascial stretch therapy, myofascial release, cupping therapy, trigger point therapy, and customized athletic recovery protocols for athletes and active adults across Maryland since 2020.

410 Muscle Therapy helps athletes, fitness enthusiasts, and active adults recover faster, eliminate pain, and restore natural movement biomechanics. All sessions combine advanced orthopedic assessment, targeted manual muscle therapy, and tailored recovery techniques designed around individual mobility goals.

## Specialized Clinical Services

- [Corrective Movement Therapy](https://410-muscletherapy.com/corrective-movement-therapy-maryland/): Functional movement restoration and neuromuscular re-education
- [Sports Massage Therapy](https://410-muscletherapy.com/maryland-sports-massage-therapist/): Pre-event and post-event athletic bodywork
- [Infrared Therapy](https://410-muscletherapy.com/infrared-therapy-maryland/): Cellular repair, deep heat circulation, and tissue relaxation
- [Fascial Stretch Therapy](https://410-muscletherapy.com/maryland-fascial-stretch-therapy/): Table-based assisted stretching to decompress joints and lengthen fascia
- [Hot Towel Massage](https://410-muscletherapy.com/hot-towel-massage-maryland/): Soothing thermal therapy to soften dense muscle tension
- [Myofascial Release Therapy](https://410-muscletherapy.com/myofascial-release-therapy-maryland/): Sustained pressure to dissolve chronic fascial restrictions
- [Acupressure Massage](https://410-muscletherapy.com/acupressure-massage-maryland/): Targeted trigger point stimulation for nervous system relief
- [Cupping Therapy](https://410-muscletherapy.com/cupping-therapy-maryland/): Decompressive negative pressure to accelerate lymphatic drainage
- [Hot Stone Massage](https://410-muscletherapy.com/hot-stone-massage-maryland/): Heated basalt stones for deep neuromuscular release
- [Deep Tissue Massage](https://410-muscletherapy.com/deep-tissue-massage-maryland/): Focused structural pressure targeting chronic muscular pain
